requiredMetrics.definition: Admission request to ready session, with allocation, provider, persistence and browser-connect stages separated.
Accepted user turn or explicit greeting request to the first audible assistant frame.
User speech-start or interrupt request to confirmed output stop and stale-buffer discard.
Accepted tool request to terminal result, separated into policy/database, connector and provider-bridge time.
Admission, completion, rejection and cleanup behavior at declared concurrent-session and tool-call loads.
Authoritative report job creation to terminal generation state, separated from delivery acceptance and verified delivery.
Oldest eligible delivery item age plus claim-to-provider-acceptance and, where available, provider-acceptance-to-verified-delivery.
